notes: PRINT A JOURNAL VOUCHER. Every journal now has a Print button, at any status — an unposted voucher is exactly what you carry round for signatures. A journal prints AS a journal: the accounts debited and credited, with totals, signed off by Prepared / Checked / Authorised. Nobody receives a journal, so it no longer asks them to. THE WITHHOLDING RATE NOW APPEARS ON THE VOUCHER. Each deduction says the rate it was taken at — "Withholding Tax Payable (Services 7.5%)". The rate is worked out from the voucher's OWN frozen figures, not from the rates set today, so a voucher reprinted next year still shows what was actually applied to it. Staff-advance vouchers carry the same. PETTY CASH RETIREMENT — THE EVIDENCE, BEFORE THE REIMBURSEMENT. A new printable statement lists every voucher a float has spent and not yet been reimbursed for, then reconciles: imprest held on the ledger, less the expenditure retired, cash remaining in hand, and the reimbursement now claimed — with the amount in words and a Retired by / Checked by / Approved by block. Print it, attach the receipts, get it signed, then reimburse. ARE YOUR DAILY EXCHANGE RATES COMPLETE? A new coverage check on the Exchange Rates screen says how many days in a period you hold a rate for, and lists the ones you do not. Reporting carries the last rate forward across a gap, so a missing week looks exactly like a weekend in the figures — this is how you tell them apart before a donor does. PRINTED DOCUMENTS SIT PROPERLY ON THE PAGE. Every schedule and voucher now puts its signature block at the foot of the sheet rather than stranded in the middle of it. NO DATABASE CHANGE: your books and settings are untouched and this installs straight over the previous version. Please still take a backup first — Backup & Export, Back up now.
